hh_electricity.label: Households with electricity
hh_electricity.note: A charging constraint on any phone-based process, and the steepest wealth gradient of any indicator here.

hh_mobile_phone.label: Households possessing a mobile telephone
hh_mobile_phone.note: Self-reported. Household-level: it does not say whether the person being enrolled can use the phone.

internet_f.label: Women who used the internet in the past 12 months

internet_m.label: Men who used the internet in the past 12 months

literacy_f.label: Women's literacy
literacy_f.note: Kept separate from the male figure throughout; never averaged.

literacy_m.label: Men's literacy
literacy_m.note: Kept separate from the female figure throughout; never averaged.

mobile_money_f.label: Women using a mobile phone for financial transactions

mobile_money_m.label: Men using a mobile phone for financial transactions

phone_own_f.label: Women who own a mobile phone

phone_own_m.label: Men who own a mobile phone

pop_total.label: Population
pop_total.note: Modelled projection, not a census count. Madagascar's last census was 2018.

account_ownership.indicator_name: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider (% of population ages 15+)
account_ownership.source: Global Findex, via World Bank Indicators API

wealth_gradient_withheld.internet_f: no unweighted case count for Fourth, Highest, Lowest, Middle, Second (API returned '')
